audit_kind: independent source audit; no compiler was run

checks.name: p length and entry bounds
checks.detail: Check demands p.length=2k and bounds every list entry; check_good transfers these to every valid index using getD_mem.

checks.name: q length and inverse direction
checks.detail: q.map(array lookup p)=range(2k) implies q.length=2k. Every q entry is checked below2k. Reading indexj yields p[q[j]]=j, the direction required by Full.check_good and permWord_injective.

checks.name: array/list agreement
checks.detail: array_getD proves unconditional equality p.toArray.getD j0=p.getD j0, with identical default0. Valid-index proofs eliminate accidental default use in inverse transport.

checks.name: half preservation
checks.detail: p.zipIdx checks k≤source iff k≤destination for every actual list entry. zip_mem transfers exactly to eachj<2k.

checks.name: forbidden pool direction
checks.detail: The checked condition is pool⊆map(Masked.fast,pool), unchanged from Full.Check after Masked.fast_eq; with injectivity this preserves freshness under the word map.

checks.name: arbitrary Nat and high bits
checks.detail: Masked.fast_eq assumes only p.length=width and applies to every Nat x. Its explicit tail (x/2^width)*2^width preserves all bits≥width; Full.fast and permWord preserve the same tail. No finite-word bound is silently assumed.

checks.name: group and action replay
checks.detail: checked_actions uses checked base generators, Full.good_id and Full.good_comp. recipeCheck bounds earlier-group and generator references; actionCheck bounds references by n+1, matching group_size.

checks.name: scope of result
checks.detail: Linear.check_good proves the original Full.Good. It constructs an original Full.Check proof internally and does not weaken run transport or rewrite the target predicate.

limitations: Compilation metadata was inspected rather than reproduced.
This audit does not claim a measured linear runtime for the entire checker: pool membership and masked-word evaluation have their own costs.
